rationale: HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper.pad_granularity must equal 128 when HybridEP is enabled. Detection reads a module attribute at init time and compares to a configured constant. Layer is schema_topo_precond: precond guard is 'HybridEP dispatcher active' (rule does not apply when only MXFP8 path is used). Borderline P4 vs P8: chose P4 because the attribute value depends on runtime config selection between MXFP8 (32) and HybridEP (128); needs a runtime hook reading module attr, not a pure static class assertion. Category control_flow per config_invariant -> control_flow mapping. Tier 6 because detection needs named_modules class snapshot + module attr inspection.
